about: Tasker 166 eval set: the questions 'find connections' must answer, each as the structured query_knowledge call a chat model should make. Free (SQL over the graph). Grow it from real asks. Names of private people stay out of this file: the person question takes its person from --person or from the top answer to 'across-work'.
